statements.status_notes: Debian fixed this for trixie in libevent 2.1.13-stable-1~deb13u1 (DSA-6493-1), which ships the upstream 2.1.13-stable point release, and the DHI build of that Debian version carries the fix. The upstream fix is two commits: https://github.com/libevent/libevent/commit/ac38703b2d312200c4f967f02936af0118d384a0 rejects duplicate or malformed Transfer-Encoding and Content-Length combinations and parses comma-separated Transfer-Encoding lists, and https://github.com/libevent/libevent/commit/10abb34b8dc3e1184de315dd261ce4b77563cda6 reads chunk-size lines with EVBUFFER_EOL_CRLF_STRICT so a bare LF no longer terminates them. Checked by inspecting the DHI Debian packages on amd64 and arm64 with their debug symbols. The evhttp_check_transfer_encoding_ and evhttp_str_is_chunked_ functions added by the first commit are present in the libevent-2.1 and libevent-extra-2.1 shared libraries and in the libevent.a and libevent_extra.a static archives, and the chunk-size read in evhttp_read_body in the libevent-2.1 shared library passes the strict CRLF mode; builds without the fix have neither. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-63382 and https://github.com/libevent/libevent/security/advisories/GHSA-q39v-w2g7-gr8j.
